acceptanceCriteria: A numbered deviation selects a Corvint loop target whose base..target range adds no sealed CEM (for example the last pre-seal commit of the head PR), or drops the seal from the loop clone as the refusal instructs, with the reason recorded.
The Corvint run reaches a C3 verdict on the next candidate.
body:
The Corvint preregistration (digest 58d68a6f...) pins corpus head 94ca556f, a merge of PR #287 whose first-parent range fc594fa6..94ca556f adds .corvint/changes/429e920c...cem.json. The harness loop runs dogfood change at base=head^ and target=head, and the candidate correctly refuses `dogfood-change: REFUSE sealed-cem-in-change` (reproduced on a clone at 94ca556f with the rc.1 binary). Every Corvint merge carries its PR's seal commit, so the loop rehearsal (C3) can never bind on a Corvint merge target. The beamfall/core target e8655b08 is a single-parent commit with no sealed CEM and is not affected.

2026-09-28 verified existing progress: commit 4e85707480c0495ba10096e79d356556a5c3d7b1 adds preregistration deviation 1 and loopTarget a5a7412c91857773ccc3e61bf197bc22725ac57c; benchmarks/untouched-repository-v1/corvint/preregistration.json records the superseded run and reason. docs/build-log/2026-09-27-v1-0432-0433-untouched-harness-rc2.md records smoke evidence and explicitly distinguishes it from a qualification result. Criterion 1 is implemented. Remaining: criterion 2, a Corvint C3 verdict on the next immutable candidate, through V1-0019. No new candidate qualification was run in this bug-fix batch. Ticket remains OPEN.

completion.reason: Criterion 1: preregistration deviation 1 selects loop target a5a7412c, which adds no sealed CEM (commit 4e857074). Criterion 2: the Corvint run-002 on the published 1.0.0-rc.2 candidate reached verdicts on all three jobs, including completion (12 of 12 informative, no false complete verdict); no run aborted. Evidence: docs/build-log/2026-10-06-v1-0019-rc2-runs.md at 202606bbf5b82a8e561d02540977407f75cf1569 (PR beamfall/corvint#631; the digest is that file's sha256).

title: Corvint untouched-repository preregistration pins the loop target at a PR merge whose range adds a sealed CEM
